name: roxadustat
human_exposure: approved EU (2021), JP, CN; not FDA-approved (no openFDA label, no FAERS record)
exposure_numbers: not extracted beyond the label statements below
protein_binding: about 99% (albumin); apparent volume of distribution 24 L
csf_brain_datum: no brain-concentration datum in the label sections read

name: nirogacestat
human_exposure: approved US (2023) for adult progressing desmoid tumours
exposure_numbers: steady state Cmax 508 ng/mL, AUC0-tau 3,370 ng.h/mL; bioavailability 19%
